summary: Tested My Patterns 7-session auto re-evaluation refactor. Backend pytest suite (test_patterns_redismiss.py) 3/3 PASSED (dismissed→hidden until 7 sessions, manual reset wipes v1+v2, legacy list migration into v2 stamped at current session_count). Frontend UI 12/13 checks PASSED against preview URL: no 'Clear All' button, gear icon present, popover opens on click / closes on outside-click / closes on Escape, Reset button disabled state wired to hasDismissed, dismissing patterns triggers all-dismissed empty state with '7 new sessions' / 're-evaluate' copy, Reset triggers POST /api/me/patterns/clear returning 200, menu closes after Reset and patterns re-surface immediately.
critical_code_review_comments: MyPatternsSection.jsx — clean implementation of the contextual gear menu; hasDismissed correctly derives from patterns.length - active.length so disabled state auto-updates.

Server: _effective_dismissed_pattern_keys correctly migrates legacy list into v2 stamped at current session_count and drops keys once session_count - at >= 7. Post-response the endpoint also $unsets stale v2 entries — good hygiene.
Note (out-of-scope per main agent): pre-existing `_pattern_key(p)` misuse inside `_generate_recommendation_notification` was NOT flagged as requested.
